bars.text: Six wins by knockout — I don't decide fights, I end them.

bars.text: Horizontal spinner, waist-high blade, your armor's just confetti.
Twelve mentions and the sentiment's negative — nobody's chanting for you.

bars.text: Two knockouts in eight fights? That flipper's more polite than lethal.

bars.text: Sixty-two point five percent, five and three — that's the math, champ.

bars.text: My opponents win fifty-eight point five — I fight the hard bracket.

bars.text: You're six and five, barely above a coin flip with a blade on it.

bars.text: Hype nineteen and a half points over your results — that's a loan, not a legacy.
bars.fact: Tombstone is the crowd's darling and the record does not back it up: fan hype sits +19.5 points above what its results predict.

bars.text: Thirty-eight mentions, plus point one four — the arena knows my name.

bars.text: You're twelve point nine better than your hype and still can't get a chant.
bars.fact: HYDRA is a quiet killer — nobody talks about it, but it is 12.9 points better than its hype implies.

bars.text: A flipper needs the floor; I bring the wall to you in pieces.
Your own timeline says the meta moved on and you never adapted.
bars.fact: Top fan post about HYDRA (x): "the meta has moved on and they haven't adapted"

bars.text: I've been knocked out once. You've been counted out three times.
